description: Potential Jan 11 monarchist rally remains an unverified lead. AP result headline and AP-origin LBC/Yahoo syndications are discovery-only; the AP affected-source hold remains pending exact scope. No body or AP variant was requested. Local Nepali query Q009 did not surface direct independent execution/attendance evidence; it surfaced an RPP tea-reception story, which is not treated as the same event. Exact AP target: https://apnews.com/article/8dcb00d95fd983cb840857519cb3d6b8. Existing receipt_003 was a manual-review/no-match receipt before later source-card changes and is not permission.
required_followup: Search permitted non-AP-origin contemporaneous local/regional sources for Jan 11 actual gathering, event site/date, state-directed demand and simultaneous crowd size. Do not open AP or AP-origin variants until scope is resolved.

description: E002 NEST marches occurred in seven provinces, but S006 gives no province-level city/site list or site-level turnout. Nationwide scope is organizational, not a basis for summing attendees across sites.
required_followup: Find separate location/attendance reports for individual Jan 9 gatherings; establish whether any one site reached 50 and whether one national organized action or distinct local events is the best description.

description: E003 Jan 25 Acharya march attendance is unquantified; the KPost retrospective’s “scores” is ambiguous at the >=50 cutoff. KPost accounts are same-outlet; Nepal Press corroborates protest occurrence but not attendance.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous independent local reporting or primary organizer records with site-specific simultaneous attendance. Resolve end/response only with explicit report.

description: E005 Jan 29 has no numeric turnout. Himalayan News Service calls the gathering a “mass demonstration”; KPost says “large number”. The owner proposes inclusion using the contemporaneous qualitative term but leaves its adequacy for independent review.
required_followup: Independent reviewer assess whether “mass demonstration” clearly entails at least 50; search any feasible independent site-specific turnout evidence and explicit closure.

description: C001 Kurmi sit-in began Dec 29, 2022 and was still underway at the Jan 31 interview/Feb 2 retrospective; simultaneous participant count and exact end date are unknown.
required_followup: Use later-month reports to establish whether/when the sit-in ended and whether turnout is ever reported; do not convert presence of one activist or duration into crowd size.

description: Regional/sector discovery remains bounded: the Jan 9 NEST source says seven provinces but identifies no sites; targeted event searches concentrated on Kathmandu. General Jan 1–8 English and broad Nepali Jan 1–24 searches returned mostly later-year or unrelated results. Local provincial outlet coverage and other sectors are not systematically resolved.
required_followup: Continue feasible provincial/local outlet and sector checks during Q1; test Jan 1–8, Jan 12–24 and Jan 30–31 windows with concrete regional and labor/education/health/cost queries; document any relevant returned results or why unavailable.

description: The Jan 27 squatters’ march, Jan 29 road-expansion/KMC demonstration, and ongoing vendor mobilization share urban evictions/public-space themes, but the current bodies do not establish a single continuous episode or prove that announced later vendor actions were executed.
required_followup: Review February and March sources for explicit organizer/episode links, later execution of announced phase-wise vendor protests, and closure; do not merge events based only on a shared policy issue.
